text: None of them knew. <break time="0.8s" /> The color of the sky. <break time="0.8s" /> For their eyes stayed fixed. <break time="0.8s" /> On the waves that swept toward them. <break time="0.8s" /> Across the gray sea. <break time="0.8s" /> The waves were the color of slate. <break time="0.8s" /> Except for their tops. <break time="0.8s" /> Which were foaming white. <break time="0.8s" /> And every man in the boat. <break time="0.8s" /> Knew the colors of the sea. <break time="0.8s" /> Many a man owns. <break time="0.8s" /> A bathtub larger than the little dinghy. <break time="0.8s" /> Which rose and fell on each wave. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a wild horse. <break time="0.8s" /> The cook sat. <break time="0.8s" /> In the bottom of the boat. <break time="0.8s" /> Bailing out the water. <break time="0.8s" /> His eyes fixed. <break time="0.8s" /> On the thin edge. <break time="0.8s" /> That separated him from the ocean. <break time="0.8s" /> The oiler and the correspondent. <break time="0.8s" /> Each pulled an oar. <break time="0.8s" /> And in the bow lay the captain. <break time="0.8s" /> Who had been hurt. <break time="0.8s" /> When the ship went down. <break time="0.8s" /> The captain was sad and quiet. <break time="0.8s" /> For he had seen his ship sink. <break time="0.8s" /> And a captain never forgets. <break time="0.8s" /> The loss of his ship. <break time="0.8s" /> We are not far from the house of refuge. <break time="0.8s" /> Near Mosquito Inlet Light. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the cook. <break time="0.8s" /> And they will pick us up. <break time="0.8s" /> As soon as they see us. <break time="0.8s" /> But the correspondent replied. <break time="0.8s" /> That houses of refuge had no crews. <break time="0.8s" /> For they were only places. <break time="0.8s" /> Where food and clothes were stored. <break time="0.8s" /> Well, we are not there yet. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the oiler. <break time="0.8s" /> And the argument ended. <break time="0.8s" /> The men turning their eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> Back to the waves.
